description: Discover and invoke the canonical recon CLI for durable, reusable external-source analysis of repositories, websites, documentation, markets, competitors, papers, and other sources when the report must become canonical evidence. Use it to search the web for reusable evidence, research a topic, market, or competitor, capture or crawl a bounded site section, find and verify scholarly papers, collect X/Twitter or YouTube source metadata, or analyze another project's agents, skills, commands, and workflows. Routes design-system work through its `recon:design` mode: cloning a site's look, mining or documenting a design system, extracting design tokens, typography, spacing, layout, or repeated components, and preparing reusable UI-library inputs. Do not use for a one-off web lookup or page fetch, or ordinary code editing that needs no durable evidence record.
